app.name: Someday
app.tagline: Things to do or find out about some day.
app.offline: You are offline. Changes are saved here and sent when you are back online.

home.emptyIntro: Nothing here yet. What would you like to do or find out about some day?

common.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

auth.setupMissingToken: This setup link has no token. Use the link with ?token=… from your BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_TOKEN.
auth.setupDisabled: Setup is already done. Log in instead.
auth.badSetupToken: That setup token is not valid.
auth.signupIntro: Someday uses passkeys instead of passwords: you log in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN. No email needed.
auth.displayNameHint: Shown to people you share lists with.
auth.badInvite: This invite is invalid, expired or already used.
auth.inviteRequired: You need an invite to join this Someday.
auth.registrationClosed: This Someday is not accepting new accounts.
auth.recoveryIntro: Each code lets you log in once if you lose all your passkeys. They are shown only now. Store them somewhere safe, such as a password manager.
auth.addThisDevice: Add this device to my account (link or code)
auth.badRecovery: That recovery code is invalid or already used.
auth.mustRegisterIntro: You logged in with a recovery code. Create a passkey on this device to continue.
auth.notSupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
auth.alreadyRegistered: This device already has a passkey for this account.
auth.unknownPasskey: This passkey is not registered here.
auth.accountDisabled: This account has been disabled by an administrator.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

link.addDeviceIntro: Passkeys do not always sync between phones and computers. Open a one-time link on the other device to create a passkey there.
link.orOpen: Scan the code with the other device, or open this link there:
link.orType: Or go to /link there and type:
link.pickNumber: Which number does the other device show? Picking the wrong one cancels the link.
link.approved: Approved. Finish on the other device.
link.wrongNumber: Wrong number. The link has been cancelled.
link.deviceAdded: The other device has been added.
link.tooMany: You already have 3 active links. Cancel one first.
link.requireApproval: Require approval from this device when a link is used
link.enterCodeIntro: On a device where you are logged in, open Settings → Add another device, and type the code shown there.
link.pickThisNumber: On your other device, pick this number:
link.waiting: Waiting for approval on your other device…
link.readyIntro: Create a passkey for {name}'s account on this device.
link.notFound: That link or code is not valid. It may have expired or been used.
link.expired: This link has expired or was already used.

security.title: Security
security.lastPasskey: You cannot delete your only passkey.
security.deletePasskeyConfirm: Delete the passkey “{label}”? Devices logged in with it are logged out.
security.addPasskeyHere: Add a passkey on this device
security.newCodesConfirm: Create 10 new recovery codes? The old ones stop working.

invites.title: Invite someone
invites.intro: An invite link lets one person create an account here. It works once.
invites.created: Send this link to one person. It expires on {date}.

settings.quietHint: Notifications that are not urgent wait until quiet hours end. 24-hour clock, HH:MM.
settings.notifyWindow: When an idea's season or window opens, or closes in a week
settings.notifyShared: When others add ideas or share what they did on shared lists
settings.snoozeDays: “Not now” hides an idea for this many days

push.title: Push on this device
push.enable: Turn on notifications on this device
push.enabledToast: Notifications are on for this device
push.thisDeviceOn: Notifications are on for this device.
push.notConfigured: This server has no push keys configured.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications.
push.iosInstall: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work after adding Someday to the home screen: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”, and open it from there.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.
push.testBody: Notifications from Someday work on this device.
push.passkeyAddedBody: New passkey added: {label}, {time}. Not you? Open Someday to revoke it.
push.window_closes: Its window closes in a week.
push.window_seasonEnds: The season ends in a week.

notice.notMeConfirm: Remove this passkey and log out every device that used it?
notice.revoked: The passkey was removed and its devices logged out.

admin.forbidden: Only administrators can see this page.
admin.disableConfirm: Disable {name}? They are logged out everywhere and cannot log in until enabled again.

reason.date_ends_today: Last chance: the window closes today

visibility.privateHint: Nobody else sees it or knows it exists.
visibility.anonymousHint: Others see how many have done it, not who.
visibility.sharedHint: Everyone on the list sees your name, date and note.
visibility.tooFew: Not available: too few members on this list to stay anonymous.

item.title: What
item.notesHint: Supports simple formatting: **bold**, *italic*, lists and links.
item.repeatable: Something to do again and again (stays open after “Done”)
item.contextHint: All optional. Anything left unset fits every filter.
item.monthsHint: Pick the months it is possible in, e.g. September to March for the northern lights. None = all year.
item.tagsHint: Separated by commas, e.g. nature, learn
item.badWindow: “Not before” must be on or before “Not after”.
item.badLink: Links must start with http:// or https://
item.repeatableNote: Repeatable: stays open after you have done it.
item.snoozedUntil: Not now: hidden from suggestions until {date}.
item.forEveryoneConfirm: Set this to “{status}” for everyone on the list?
item.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}” and its log for everyone?

lists.title: Lists
lists.newPlaceholder: e.g. Things to do with Kari
lists.empty: No ideas on this list yet.

listSettings.title: Settings for {name}
listSettings.name: Name
listSettings.includeInSuggestions: Include this list in “Give me something”
listSettings.deleteHint: Deleted lists can be restored for 30 days, then they are gone for good.

suggest.saveDefault: Use as my default (also for nudges)
suggest.nothing: Nothing fits right now. Try fewer filters, or add more ideas.

sync.failed: A change from {time} could not be saved: {message}

join.title: Join “{list}”
join.introAnon: You are invited to this list ({role}).
join.needAccount: You need a Someday account to join.
join.invalid: This invite link has expired, been used up or withdrawn. Ask for a new one.

share.transferConfirm: Make {name} the owner of this list? You will become an editor.
share.inviteIntro: Anyone with the link can join until it expires (7 days) or is used up.
share.qrLabel: QR code for the invite link
share.threshold: Anonymous counts from this many members
share.thresholdHint: Below this, “done by N” is hidden and nobody can log anonymously: in a small group a count would reveal who it was. At least 3.
share.leaveConfirm: Leave “{name}”? You can only come back with a new invite.
share.deleteShared: Deleting removes the list for every member.

nudge.title: Nudges
nudge.intro: Now and then, at a random moment, Someday suggests something to do. Off until you turn it on.
nudge.windowHint: 24-hour clock, HH:MM. Never during quiet hours, and at most one a day.
